rules.scope: Research only; current base representations, no manual parent overrides

scope: Full ordered selection on every base technology; supported evidence forms documented separately. No manual overrides.

decisions.nameRu: Замёрзшие миры и их среда обитания

limitations: Base representations only; selected variants and their inherited effects are not covered.
Standard empire facts only; unknown predicates remain unknown, not false.
Indirect evidence: matching signed component ship_modifier fields at original technology depth one.
Production evidence: explicitly generated category modifiers, exact job category and positive building job additions.
Capacity evidence: the agreed starbase capacity mapping only; no guessing of unmapped limits.
Object/action routes and other functional evidence use the previously documented supported forms.
No frontend placement, coordinates, runtime availability or universal semantic classification claims.
